subject: TheraHealth: IAM assertions, SCIM delta export & RBAC matrix for SIG review
messages:
From: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@therahealth.com>
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: security@therahealth.com
Date: 2027-04-18T08:12:00+01:00
Subject: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion snippets for SIG evaluation

Hi Lukas / Irene,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As we prepare the SIG questionnaire, our security reviewers have asked for: 1) a SCIM delta export showing recent user and group changes for the last 30 days, 2) a short sample of SAML assertion output for a normal user login and a service account login, and 3) an RBAC mapping (owner/approver/steward) for privileged roles.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the exports as CSV/TXT and a short RBAC matrix spreadsheet? We need the artifacts uploaded to the shared drive by EOD Wednesday (2027-04-20) to stay on our review timeline. If any items are redacted or require an NDA addendum, please flag them.

Appreciate the quick turn — we can loop in legal if necessary.

Best,
Amanda Liu
Security Program Manager
TheraHealth

Attachment: SIG-ask-summary.pdf (referenced)
From: lukas.meyer@redwood.ai <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@therahealth.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-18T10:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion snippets for SIG evaluation

Amanda — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver everything you described. Quick notes:

- SCIM delta: we can export the delta as CSV (user/group changes with timestamps) and will include a brief mapping file describing the column meanings.
- SAML assertions: we will provide redacted assertion samples (removing any PII and tenant IDs as requested). Those will be TXT snippets with header/context lines.
- RBAC matrix: we'll produce an xlsx with role, role_owner, approver, last_reviewed and example member counts.

Irene will own generating the SCIM/SAML artifacts; Markus will validate the RBAC spreadsheet. We should be able to upload to the Drive link you provided by EOD 2027-04-20. If you need them sooner, tell us and we'll prioritize.

Deliverables we will attach/upload: scim_delta_20270417.csv, saml_assertions_excerpt.txt, rbac_tally_therahealth_v1.xlsx.

Lukas
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

On Apr 18, 2027, at 08:12, Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@therahealth.com> wrote:
> (original request)
From: irene.choi@redwood.ai <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@therahealth.com>
Cc: lukas.meyer@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-20T15:48:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion snippets for SIG evaluation

Amanda — attaching the requested artifacts and a short readme. Summary below.

Attachments included (uploaded to shared Drive and attached here):
- scim_delta_20270417.csv — 30-day delta export for TheraHealth tenant; columns: change_type, object_type, external_id, displayName, email, timestamp, changed_by
- saml_assertions_excerpt.txt — two assertion snippets: normal user login (redacted email/tenant), service-account login (service-account identifier replaced with SERVICE_ACCOUNT_X)
- rbac_tally_therahealth_v1.xlsx — role roster with owner/approver columns and last_reviewed date

Redaction notes: we removed internal IP addresses and replaced tenant GUIDs with stable placeholders per our export policy. If you require raw (unredacted) samples for a signed NDA, let us know the legal contact and we will coordinate.

Validation checks performed: checksum of CSV, count match with API audit logs for the export window, and a manual sample review of 10 assertions to confirm redaction.

Jordan — tagging you in case you want to add the rollout/retention note for SCIM exports in the SIG response. Markus, can you confirm the RBAC owners & last_reviewed fields are accurate for the privileged roles listed on sheet tab 'PrivilegedRoles'?

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: scim_delta_20270417.csv (CSV), saml_assertions_excerpt.txt (TXT), rbac_tally_therahealth_v1.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@therahealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: security@therahealth.com, lukas.meyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-20T17:30:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion snippets for SIG evaluation

Irene / Lukas — received, thank you. The artifacts look good at a glance and the redaction approach is acceptable for our SIG pack. Two small asks before we close the ticket: 1) can you add a one-line note in the Drive README listing the retention policy for SCIM exports and where the audit trail lives, and 2) for the RBAC sheet, can you mark which roles are subject to periodic certification vs. automated provisioning? If you can drop those two items in the same Drive folder before Friday EOB (2027-04-23) we'll be able to complete the questionnaire and pass to our procurement team.

I will escalate to legal only if we need the unredacted traces — thanks for offering that.

Amanda
Security Program Manager
TheraHealth
